issues.issue: Whether the risk is linked to a Convention ground (nexus)
issues.applicant_position: Claimant says the blood feud and family land dispute put his life at risk.
issues.result_text: No nexus to a Convention ground; dispute is property-based and reciprocal, not persecution.

issues.issue: Whether the claimant's shifting evidence about who was attacked is credible
issues.applicant_position: Claimant says confusion stems from the large family, depression, limited contact and two hours of testimony.
issues.result_text: Repeated unexplained changes on the victim's identity undermine credibility of the blood feud.

issues.issue: Whether the post-shooting movements and locations are credible
issues.applicant_position: Claimant says the two road routes explain the differing distances and his movements.
issues.result_text: Movement evidence inconsistent and not credible; serious negative inference drawn on the shooting.

issues.issue: Whether the blood feud documents prove the feud
issues.result_text: Supporting documents impugned given the claimant's credibility and widespread falsified blood-feud documents.

issues.issue: Whether the claimant faces risk to life, torture or cruel treatment in Albania
issues.result_text: Insufficient credible evidence of risk to life, torture or cruel treatment on return to Albania.
